effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.)
[Your Turn] For every 3 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your opponent's security stack, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP.
